summary_en: On Sept 16, China's Zhao Jiaju won the Tor des Géants trail race in Italy in 65 hours 55 minutes 22 seconds, becoming the first Chinese champion and breaking the previous course record of 66:08:22. This year's course spanned 336.1 km across Italy, France and Switzerland.

title: 韩正会见柬埔寨国王西哈莫尼和太后莫尼列

summary: 韩正会见柬埔寨国王西哈莫尼和太后莫尼列。韩正转达了习近平主席和夫人彭丽媛的亲切问候和良好祝愿，表示中柬铁杆友谊由两国老一辈领导人共同缔造和精心培育，历经风雨、坚如磐石。在两国领导人战略指引下，双边关系迈入构建新时代全天候中柬命运共同体的新阶
summary_en: Han Zheng Meets with Cambodian King Norodom Sihamoni and Queen Mother Norodom Monineath. Han Zheng conveyed the cordial greetings and best wishes of President Xi Jinping and Madame Peng Liyuan, saying that the ironclad friendship between China and Cambodia was jointly forged and carefully nurtured by the older generation of leaders of the two countries and has withstood storms and remained rock-solid. Under the strategic guidance of the leaders of the two countries, bilateral relations have entered a new stage of building a China-Cambodia community with a shared future in the new era.

summary: 9月16日，国防部长董军在北京分别同出席第十三届北京香山论坛的泰国国防部长阿敦、蒙古国国防部长巴特卢特、柬埔寨副首相兼国防大臣迪西哈、新加坡国防部长陈振声举行会谈。董军表示，当前全球治理处于关键阶段，求和平、谋发展、促合作、扬正义是共同心愿
summary_en: On Sept 16, Defense Minister Dong Jun held separate talks in Beijing with Thai Defense Minister Adun, Mongolian Defense Minister Batlut, Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Defense Minister Dith Siha, and Singapore Defense Minister Chan Chun Sing, who attended the 13th Beijing Xiangshan Forum. Dong said global governance is at a critical stage, and seeking peace, development, cooperation and justice is a shared aspiration.
